subject.title: Mobile apps: offline session cache with instant cold open (iOS + Android)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bounded local mobile transcript cache as the product direction once the iOS session-browsing and security-proof gaps are resolved?
rationale: The remaining work stores sensitive transcript text on-device and spans two mobile apps, so automation cannot choose the permanent storage, proof, and scope contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require bounded cache with proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and require iOS plus Android hardening to prove per-gateway scoping, retention bounds, OS protection, purge/reset, and offline read-only behavior before closure.

options.title: Narrow to active transcript prepaint
options.body: Accept only active-session cache-first rendering for now and split offline recent-session browsing into a separately sponsored follow-up.

options.title: Pause local transcript persistence
options.body: Reject or defer local transcript persistence until maintainers choose a stronger privacy/security design.

recommendation.title: Require bounded cache with proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require iOS plus Android hardening to prove per-gateway scoping, retention bounds, OS protection, purge/reset, and offline read-only behavior before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned and owns both the merged Android cache work and the open iOS implementation candidate.
